title: Bounded constructible etale origin of the reduced integral Hom
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension, and $X$ a scheme. Put $B_X=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ and use the ordinary unbounded derived categories and ambient relative derived internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $F_X$ be the fixed composite of the section-action derived equivalence [def-sfb-integral-section-action-transport], the quotient-normalized detailed coefficient transport and restriction along the completed coefficient isomorphism [def-sfb-integral-completed-coefficient-transport]. This reads the same object over $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$, without applying completion. Let $I$ be the ideal generated by the chosen uniformizer, and use the local-completeness and fixed-scalar residue predicates [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. Assume also that $k$ is a field of prime positive characteristic different from $\ell$, and $X$ is separated and finite type over $k$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix a legacy finite-field datum $D_0$ with $\ell
e D_0.p$. Let $K,L\in D(B_X)$ satisfy IsSfbAdicConstructible after $F_X$. Suppose the canonical integralHomReductionComparison at exponent $0+1$, for the section-action images of $K,L$, is invertible [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-comparison]. Then there exists a cochain complex $C$ of etale $\mathcal O_E/I$-module sheaves with cohomology zero outside some ordered finite interval, constructible cohomology sheaves [def-constructible-constructible], and an isomorphism in the ordinary derived category
$$Q(
u_X^*C)\simeq Q(\operatorname{sfbResidueComplex}(F_X(R\mathcal Hom_{B_X}(K,L)))).$$
Here $
u_X$ is the pro-etale/etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The conclusion imposes neither strict bounds on the terms of $C$ nor a Tor interval; those are separate bounded-representative consequences over the residue field.

proof.text: Unpack the two IsSfbAdicConstructible hypotheses to obtain bounded-cohomology etale residue complexes C_K,C_L, their constructible cohomology, and coefficient-linear derived isomorphisms from their pro-etale inverse images to the actual reductions.

The integers-of-a-finite-extension theorem identifies the exponent-one quotient with its finite residue field A. The extended absolute value of ell is less than one, so ell is zero in A; since ell is prime and A nonzero, CharP A ell. Use the normalized finite-discrete coefficient encoding to read the residue inputs as ULift(A) coefficient sheaves, preserving finite local models and all cohomology bounds.

Apply finiteField_hom_etale_witness to these etale inputs over the arbitrary ground field k. Its Hom has an etale cochain origin with bounded constructible cohomology. Only these clauses are needed here; strict bounds and the Tor conclusion are not used.

Transport the two input isomorphisms through the contravariant and covariant Hom functors. The evaluation-preserving module-object/ringed-site comparison and the coefficient maps identify the inverse of the assumed canonical reduction map with an isomorphism from this residue Hom to the fixed-scalar reduction of F_X(Hom(K,L)). Transport the etale origin and its constructible cohomology back along the residue-ring isomorphism and compose the derived isomorphisms.

theorem integralAdicHom_residue_origin
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (D₀ : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{0}) (hl : l ≠ D₀.p)
    (K L : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X))
    (hK : Scheme.IsSfbAdicConstructible X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal
      (((integralSectionDerivedEquivalence l E X).functor ⋙
        Scheme.integralDetailedTransport X l E ⋙
        Scheme.pbcDerivedRestrict (Scheme.pbcCompletedComparison X
          (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E)).hom).obj K))
    (hL : Scheme.IsSfbAdicConstructible X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal
      (((integralSectionDerivedEquivalence l E X).functor ⋙
        Scheme.integralDetailedTransport X l E ⋙
        Scheme.pbcDerivedRestrict (Scheme.pbcCompletedComparison X
          (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E)).hom).obj L))
    (hred : IsIso (WeilConjectures.integralHomReductionComparison D₀ l hl E X 0
      ((integralSectionDerivedEquivalence l E X).functor.obj K)
      ((integralSectionDerivedEquivalence l E X).functor.obj L))) :
    ∃ C : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.PbcIntegralRing l E ⧸
          (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal ^ (0 + 1)))) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero (C.homology q)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf (C.homology q)) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.PbcIntegralRing l E ⧸
          (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal ^ (0 + 1))) X).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (Scheme.sfbResidueComplex X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal
          (((integralSectionDerivedEquivalence l E X).functor ⋙
        Scheme.integralDetailedTransport X l E ⋙
        Scheme.pbcDerivedRestrict (Scheme.pbcCompletedComparison X
          (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E)).hom).obj
        (((CondensedRing.derivedHom (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X).obj
            (op K)).obj L))))
